authority: Original M in the user-provided AMNVW screenshot

measured.measurement detail: glyph-calculations.json records sample positions, local curve fits, source fingerprint, and per-letter calculations.

scale_note: The original M reference is uniformly enlarged by 3.2. Review PNGs use a 560-pixel capital height, 406-pixel lowercase body, 476-pixel short t ascender, and common baseline. Full ascenders reach the cap line; i/j dots remain separate above their short bodies. Looped descenders are aligned by the bowl, and y by the upper fork, rather than shrinking the whole letter into the body height. Their natural tails are preserved on taller canvases where needed. Wide forms receive a wider canvas rather than horizontal compression.
inferred_shape_rules: Asymmetric continuous ribbon with measured broad rising strokes and distinctly narrower returns, approximately 1.92 to 1
Soft crests and deep clean concave turns
Rounded-flat terminals and relaxed curved feet
Natural proportional widths; no geometric bubble forms

raster_cleanup.preservation: Raw generations remain intact in raw/. Review PNGs isolate the white fill, remove stray components, antialias edges, and uniformly resize each silhouette to its case-aware metrics. Original aspect ratios are retained without stretching. The i/j dots retain their shapes and remain separate above the body, centered on the upward continuation of the straight stem axis. The original M is reused rather than regenerated.

review_scope: A–Z and a–z, one Fgen call per generated letter with the same original M reference; uppercase M comes directly from the original. All fifty-two letters are connected to the word hub, with installable font changes deferred until human review.
